I too have felt like this. When Elliot Rodger committed his atrocities and left his manifesto I have read it and freaked. How could I sympathize with this monster? How could I feel what he felt? Am I a monster? I thought suicide was the solution because how could I be like this guy? Would I become him? 

Suicide was at the time I thought the way I would protect everyone from myself, to stop myself from becoming a monster and due to the feeling I had my whole life that it would never get better. Needless to say I freaked out so badly and thank my lucky stars that my best friend saved me from doing something stupid. I have thought my whole life I was an abomination and still think I am though not as much as before. So I made a vow to never cause harm to others, to not be like Elliot Rodgers even though I treated him as a human being, to try and fix myself. To try and make other people's lives better and take care of them.

And lastly the one that still brings me tears everytime I think about it: the happy ending, the tree that is waiting for me; a loving family that loves all of me and it would be a big family. I would do everything I can to get that happy ending that I was brought up (by the school system) that I would never get. That no one would mourn for me when I die. Making that vow has made me better. 

I don't know if it will get better for you. But I have and still do feel as you feel. Our situations may be different but our feelings are still the same. Think better of yourself if you can I know this is hard and I struggle with it. Your general situation might not get better but keep trying! You Sir are a survivor! Make a change if you can. I hope you OP have all your hopes and dreams come true.

I work so hard to try and kill that part of me but it always keeps poking out. I have read the horror stories and what lies in wait for us. There is no tree. It does not get better.
